fields.title: 1. Event — Primary-Source Cross-Check of the Starbase 'Gas Power + Supercompute' Complex
fields.md:
### 1-1. Original Text (③ Local Government Notice)

| Item | Original content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Issuer · document | City of Starbase, Texas — 'Notice of Public Hearing' (p. 1). File metadata creation date 2026-11-06 | ③ [Notice PDF](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67fcab04e05680343de9ea4e/6aee00848f7bbe0cdee604da_6aee005cf2854ef8fc7713ed_Public_Hearing_Notice_Tax_Abatement_Dec9_2026.pdf) (linked by the RGV Business Journal 11/8 article, accessed 2026-11-11) |
| Hearing schedule | **2026-12-09 (Wed) 19:00**, 48491 State Highway 4, Starbase — regular city commission meeting, public hearing (interested parties may speak) | Same as above |
| Subject of review | ① Property tax abatement agreement (Texas Tax Code Chapter 312) ② Related economic development agreement (Texas Local Government Code Chapter 380) — **this is a review for approval, not an approval** | Same as above |
| Applicant | Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (Texas corporation) | Same as above |
| Site | Within Starbase city limits, Cameron County, approx. **444 acres**, east of Brownsville, between Boca Chica Blvd and the Port of Brownsville, property ID 171887 · Cameron County Enterprise Zone (deemed designated as a reinvestment zone under Tax Code §312.2011) | Same as above |
| Facility | 'gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility' — built, owned and operated by SpaceX | Same as above |
| Cost | Estimated initial-phase capital investment **approx. $24 billion**, built in multiple phases, with possible future expansion | Same as above |
| **Not in** the original | Power capacity (MW), compute scale (GW · GPUs), abatement rate · term · amount, employment, construction start · operation schedule, financing method, customers | Same as above |

### 1-2. Differences Between Reports and the Original

| Statement | Source | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| '$24 billion data center and gas power plant' | ⑤ [Bloomberg 11/9](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-09/spacex-plans-24-billion-data-center-and-gas-plant-in-texas) (headline) · ⑤ [Reuters 11/9 — reprinted by Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/spacex-plans-24-billion-gas-power-plant-data-center-project-in-texas-5013083) · ⑥ [RGV Business Journal 11/8](https://www.rgvbusinessjournal.com/news/08/11/2026/spacex-seeks-economic-incentives-for-24b-starbase-data-center-and-power-plant/) | **Consistent with the original** — but the $24 billion is an 'initial-phase' estimated capital investment, not the abatement amount |
| 35 gas turbines · approx. 748MW, later 8 GE Vernova 7E units · approx. 708MW, NOx 248.86 tons per year | ⑥ [RGV Business Journal 11/8](https://www.rgvbusinessjournal.com/news/08/11/2026/spacex-seeks-economic-incentives-for-24b-starbase-data-center-and-power-plant/) (Trinity Consultants applied to TCEQ for a new air pollution source permit on SpaceX's behalf — no filing date) · ⑥ [Construction Review Online](https://constructionreviewonline.com/spacex-seeks-tax-break-for-24-billion-starbase-gas-plant-and-supercomputer/) | **Unconfirmed** — the original TCEQ application could not be found. The city notice has no capacity figure. Not used in the verdict or formulas |
| Starpipe — approx. 8-mile gas pipeline of affiliate Lone Star Mineral Development (scheduled to operate 2027-01, for a liquid methane fuel plant) | ⑤ Reuters 11/9 (citing June review documents) | Recorded only — no link to this complex in the original |
| Calls from the next Texas governor for a moratorium on new data center construction · data centers rejected in 40 of 41 local referendums | ⑤ Reuters 11/9 · ⑥ secondary reprints | Background record only — no moratorium legislation or executive order exists (Axis E item to verify) |

### 1-3. Filings · Company Materials

- **No SpaceX 8-K or IR** — the latest on EDGAR is the 11/06 8-K (Item 5.02), the latest on the IR RSS is 11/06 (① [EDGAR filing list](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json) · ② [IR RSS](https://ir.spacex.com/rss/pressrelease.aspx), checked 2026-11-11).
- EDGAR full-text search ('Starbase' + 'power plant', SpaceX CIK) returned **8 hits — all listing documents (DRS · S-1 · S-1/A · 424B4 · FWP, 2026-03 to 06)**, with 0 10-Q or 8-K hits. The context within the listing documents (whether it refers to existing launch-site power facilities) was not opened in this round (① [EDGAR full-text search](https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22Starbase%22%20%22power%20plant%22&ciks=0001181412), checked 2026-11-11).

**Verdict**: The event is **real** (local government original) — but the original is a 'plan and abatement application', not a construction start, contract or disbursement of funds. There are three paths to the judgment layer, and all three still have no numbers.

1. **Axis C (nameplate GW)**: The original does not state compute scale. The reported 748MW is **power generation** capacity, not the 'nameplate compute GW' of milestone C-2027-1 (the definition in the reported-results AI table). The two numbers are not interchanged — C-2027-1 progress stays as is (1.7GW, 9/30) (source: `state.milestones` C-2027-1 · [8-K Ex.99.1 2026-10-20](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm)).
2. **Axis D (CAPEX · financing)**: The $24 billion is about 1.2 quarters of 3Q26 consolidated CAPEX of $19,593M (formula: 24,000 ÷ 19,593 = 1.22). Without phases or a timeline it cannot be divided by annual CAPEX, and the original does not say whether it is self-funded or an external structure like the $40 billion GPU lease → not an input to D-2027-1 (additional financing of $50 billion or less · no equity issuance). The commitments and CAPEX notes in the 4Q26 10-K are the checkpoint.
3. **Axis E (permits · politics)**: Three strands — local abatement (12/9), state air permit (TCEQ), and state government data center policy. The design gap that Axis E has no 'data center environmental regulation' milestone was already registered by the 11/03 round as a monthly item — this adds one case (the same 'self-supplied gas power' structure as the T10 Colossus turbine lawsuit) (source: Tables 1-1 and 1-2 · `state.open_questions_for_next_run` · `state.triggers_next_12m[T10]`).

**Measurement-layer share (registration only)**: ① The monitor **linked this event to T1 (4Q26 results) — wrong** (T1 is a checkpoint for earnings disclosure; this event is a local permit). This round newly established T12. ② Local government notices (City of Starbase) and TCEQ permit applications are not measurement-layer sources — notice PDF created (11/6) → local paper (11/8) → Bloomberg · Reuters (11/9) → engine (11/11): it was caught **5 days later** than the original (source: tables above · `data/spacex_watch.json` due).
